(WebFetch — Times of Israel liveblog, 25 July 2026)

US Fires on Tanker Evading Iran Blockade:
Navy Captain Tim Hawkins (US Central Command): "We disabled the tanker after the crew attempted to run the blockade at least four times prior."
Hawkins added: "The crew was repeatedly warned, didn't comply, and US forces on scene disabled the ship after firing into its engine room."
(Ship name not disclosed in the report.)

Trump Plane Switch: According to The New York Times, President Trump switched aircraft in Turkey due to information about a "credible threat" by Iranian proxies. The threat concerned the older aircraft's inferior defensive capabilities, not the newer Qatar-supplied plane.

Netanyahu's US Visit: Trump confirmed at the White House Correspondents' Association Dinner that PM Netanyahu will visit the US next week. Netanyahu's office specified the visit will run Monday through Wednesday, including a Tuesday meeting with Trump and attendance at a Senator Lindsey Graham memorial service.

West Bank: The liveblog noted settler rampages across West Bank villages on 24-25 July.
